style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: the camera circles the fennec, the world flies at him; he works his whole body every beat; the vulture moves only in his beats; the fennec's jaw opens on every syllable; the camera never stops, new shot size every beat; the fennec fills half the frame except the three close-up beats
character: the fennec: desert fennec fox, sandy fur, huge radar ears swivelling to every sound, utterly serious, dreads water; ONE vulture concierge: white jacket, gold buttons, beige bow tie, bulging breast pocket, on a low lifeguard chair at the pool edge
props: ONE pink gift box with a bow
environment: desert resort pool at noon: white bungalows with sharp corners, blue water, striped loungers, palms in tubs of sand
lighting: hard noon sun, high exposure, sparkling caustics, coin glints

audio.pronunciation: ko-ROB-ka o-be-SHCHA-la zo-lo-TY-ye GO-ry. GO-ry, KA-zhet-sya, GDE-to za ug-LOM
audio.pacing: first word at 0.5; 0.5-5.3 one continuous flow, no pause between sentences; after 5.3 not a word, sfx go on
audio.lip_sync: 0.5-5.3 jaw wide open on every syllable
audio.sfx: jackpot jingle soft under the voice, coins, splash

timeline.a: on a striped lounger the fennec yanks the bow off the pink box and flips it upside down: empty
the fennec springs off the lounger onto the hot tiles, shaking the open box upside down at belly level, jaw working, ears drooping
timeline.c: dutch tilt, low at tile level

timeline.a: a jackpot jingle bursts from a bungalow corner, coins spray out; the fennec dashes to it, box in paw, jaw working
timeline.c: low ahead of the running fennec

timeline.a: the fennec skids to a teetering halt on the pool rim, toes curling back from the water, jaw working, ears snapping to the corner
close-up: the fennec lunges into the lens, his muzzle filling the frame, jaw working, one ear swivelling back
the jingle jumps to a farther corner, coins skitter there; the fennec pivots on his hind paws, muzzle to camera, ears tracking it, jaw working, box low at his hip
the fennec snaps to attention, box under one arm, leaps feet-first into the pool toward the lens; a sheet of water flies at the lens
timeline.c: water level, spray at the lens

timeline.a: close-up: only his two huge ears stick out of the water like periscopes and dart into the lens, ears quivering, filling the frame, swivelling to the chair
the camera hurls itself to the vulture's pocket, background rushing; it jingles, the vulture snaps a wing over it, a coin plinks into the pool
timeline.c: hurl from the ears to the pocket

timeline.a: the soaked fennec hoists the flapping vulture upside down by the ankles over the box at his feet
the fennec shakes him; a mountain of gold coins pours from the jacket into the box, heaping up in it
timeline.c: coins falling past the lens into the box

timeline.a: the vulture slips onto the coins; the fennec wrings water out of one ear like a towel, water streams out
close-up: the fennec pops into the lens, wrung ear dripping, muzzle filling the frame, and winks

must_appear: close-ups 3.6, 5.9, 9.2; hurl 6.6; coins into box 7.8; ear wring 8.4; wink 9.2
negative_prompt: subtitles, letters, watermark, microphone, a second fennec, a third character, duplicate props, coins coming out of the box, closed muzzle while speaking, paw over mouth, zoom, wide shot, top-down view, slow motion, scene change, English speech, accented Russian, any word after the last line, floating objects
